Cybercore

Apps from Cybercore Tech: privacy-first, offline-first tools with a CYBERGRID look. Every APK here is the exact signed release published on GitHub, re-verified (SHA-256 + developer signing certificate) before it is listed.

Currently it serves 4 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://cybercoretech.github.io/fdroid/repo
